desc: Parse K, S, T and strip longest common prefix/suffix with non-overlap guard; early-exit on |len diff| > K and exact matches.

Implement furthest-reaching (Landau-Vishkin) Levenshtein with 2^61-1 rolling-hash LCP jumps, band [-K,K], correct insert/delete/replace transitions, carry, final test V[K+d_star] >= n. Passes samples 1–3.
Brute-force fuzzer (alphabet 1–3, lengths 1–9, K 1–4, ~30k cases) vs O(nm) edit-distance DP: 0 mismatches.
Benchmark on 5e5/5e5 adversarial inputs (random lowercase; 'a'+X+'a' vs 'b'+X+'b') with K=20: ~0.55–0.6s, comfortably under limits.
